role: Software Engineer Internship - AI Platform Team
jd:
Why choose an internship with Wellmark?  We strive to offer meaningful work that supports your professional development and creates value for the team. During Wellmark’s 2027 Summer Internship Program , you will apply what you have learned in school, gain experience in the health insurance industry, learn from subject matter experts and leaders, and build relationships with fellow interns and technology professionals. 
 If you are eager to learn, collaborate, develop customer-focused solutions, and grow into an exciting technology career, we hope you will consider an internship with us.

What’s the AI Platform, Enterprise AI Services, and Data Engineering teams?  
 Our AI Platform, Enterprise AI Services, and Data Engineering teams work together to create the trusted data, governed platforms, reusable intelligence, engineering patterns, and responsible AI capabilities that support modern technology solutions across Wellmark. 
 The AI Platform team builds and operates the governed foundation for safe, secure, reliable, and scalable AI. The Enterprise AI Services team builds reusable domain assistants, agents, shared AI services, and agent skills that can be consumed across products, portfolios, and business areas. The Data Engineering team builds and supports the pipelines, data products, APIs, services, and lakehouse capabilities that make trusted data available for applications, analytics, and AI. Interns may contribute across all three areas and learn how trusted data, platform capabilities, and reusable intelligence come together in production-ready AI solutions. 
 What projects might I support?  
 Although projects are subject to change, interns may work together as a small delivery team on a shared, end-to-end project. Depending on project needs and interests, you may: 
 
• Collaborate with fellow interns, engineers, product partners, and subject matter experts to define a problem, divide work, integrate components, and demonstrate a working solution.  
• Build or enhance data ingestion and transformation pipelines that prepare trusted data for analytics, applications, or AI use cases.  
• Work with structured and semi-structured data using lakehouse and medallion concepts, including bronze, silver, and gold data layers.  
• Develop APIs, microservices, serverless components, or event-driven workflows that connect data and AI capabilities.  
• Support AI platform capabilities that enable the safe, secure, responsible, observable, and scalable use of generative AI, large language models, agents, or related services.  
• Build or enhance reusable enterprise AI services, domain assistants, agents, agent skills, prompts, tools, knowledge integrations, or workflows using approved platform capabilities.  
• Apply data quality, governance, lineage, security, privacy, and access-control considerations throughout the solution lifecycle.  
• Create automated tests, monitor solution health, troubleshoot technical issues, and improve reliability and performance.  
• Use infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices to make cloud deployments repeatable, reviewable, and maintainable.  
• Create technical documentation, code samples, architecture diagrams, and best-practice guidance that help other teams adopt the solution.  
• Present project outcomes, lessons learned, and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.  Ready to bring your strengths to Wellmark? Here’s what’s next!  Review the qualifications below. We do not expect one candidate to have experience with every technology listed. We are looking for curious, collaborative problem-solvers who bring a solid foundation and are excited to learn across AI, cloud, software, and data engineering. 
 This internship will start in May of 2027, working a hybrid schedule from our headquarters in Des Moines.  Interns will be aligned to a shared project with opportunities to contribute across AI Platform, Enterprise AI Services, and Data Engineering.

• Current junior, senior, or master’s student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.  
• Foundational knowledge of software development, data concepts, or cloud computing, with an interest in artificial intelligence, data engineering, platform engineering, or related disciplines.  
• Experience through coursework, projects, internships, research, or personal learning with at least one programming or query language such as Python, SQL, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, .NET/C#, or C++.  
• Basic understanding of databases, data structures, APIs, data pipelines, cloud services, or machine learning concepts.  
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail.  
• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, gather information, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.  
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical partners.  
• Ability to manage priorities, adapt to changing needs, work independently, and contribute effectively within a team.  
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office products and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams.  Preferred:
 
• Previous internship, co-op, campus leadership role, research position, or professional work experience. 
• Coursework or project experience building data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, APIs, microservices, cloud applications, analytics solutions, or AI-enabled applications.  
• Exposure to AWS services, serverless or event-driven architecture, S3-based data lakes, lakehouse concepts, or distributed data processing.  
• Experience with Python, PySpark, SQL, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS Glue, CDK, Iceberg, Parquet, automated testing, Git, or CI/CD practices.  
• Exposure to generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, model evaluation, AI governance, observability, data governance, or data quality concepts.  
• Coursework or project exposure to AI agents, domain assistants, prompt and tool integration, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation, or reusable AI services.  
• Experience using modern AI tools to support software development, research, testing, documentation, or productivity.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 
 An Equal Opportunity Employer 
 The policy of Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield is to recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. 
 Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact us at careers@wellmark.com 

 Please inform us if you meet the definition of a " Covered DoD official ". 

 At this time, Wellmark is not considering applicants for this position that require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. For additional information around work authorization needs please refer to the following resources: Nonimmigrant Workers and Green Card for Employment-Based Immigrants  

 Wellmark supports and expects the responsible use of AI for our workforce! We welcome the responsible use of these tools by job seekers as well and are interested in learning from you; you will have an opportunity in the application process to share which tools you used and how you applied them.

Job Description 

 What unites us and makes Constellation Brands such an exciting place to work is our collective passion for building brands that people love. We are all brand builders – regardless of our position in the company.  Are you looking for a great remote intern experience while you finish your studies?  We are interviewing candidates to join our growing agile development team at Constellation Brands.  You are in the driver’s seat with agile development because you decide what features or “user stories” you feel comfortable committing to.  Our team develops sales applications using a variety of technologies, including but not limited to: 

• JavaScript/NodeJS/React/Next.js 
• React Native 
• Python (Agentic AI) 
• Postgres 
• Snowflake  
 You will gain full-stack, resume-building experience developing valuable features for our sales team.  Our senior engineers are always online to answer your questions and provide constructive feedback via code reviews.  Please consider applying if you are passionate about technology and want to work with a fun-loving multinational team. 

 Responsibilities 

• Learn and participate in our agile development process, including our online user story grooming sessions and sprint planning meetings. 
• Leverage AI to facilitate the development process. 
• Learn our coding standards, design patterns, and best practices as defined in our documentation. 
• Evaluate “user stories” and assign points for the difficulty level.  Use this to determine what stories you feel comfortable committing to. 
• Complete your committed user stories in two-week sprints. 
• Create or update JavaScript and Python APIs to support new application functionality. 
• Develop new features for our web using React or iOS mobile applications using React Native. 
• Learn and participate in our GitHub pull request and review process. 
• Attend our 15-minute online scrum sessions with other team members daily or as your schedule allows. 
• Perform manual and automated quality assurance tests to verify completed user stories. 
• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues and code defects.  

 Qualifications 

• Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a similar program 
• Positive attitude and receptive to feedback 
• Passion for applying technology to solve real-world problems.  Have you participated in a hackathon?  Let us know. 
• Completed coursework using a high-level programming language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, etc. 
• Some knowledge of relational database systems 
• Comfortable working with JSON data 
• Course or project work involving REST APIs 
• Familiarity with Git version control 
• Course or project work involving web or mobile user interfaces 
• Solid written and verbal communication; strong interest and ability to collaborate with team members  
 Physical Requirements/Other 

• Must be able to work on a computer for extended periods of time 
• You will need a relatively quiet space to work and participate in online meetings 

 The salary range for this role is: 

 $19.00- $32.00 an hour 

 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, the prevailing minimum wage for the location, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees. 

 Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law 
 
 Location 
Rochester, New York 
 Additional Locations 
 
 Job Type 
Full time 
 Job Area 
Internships 
 Equal Opportunity 
 Constellation Brands is committed to a continuing program of equal employment opportunity. All persons have equal employment opportunities with Constellation Brands, regardless of their sex, race, color, age, religion, creed, sexual orientation, national origin or citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition (cancer or genetic characteristics), marital status, gender (including gender identity or gender expression), familial status, military or veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions (or any other group or category within the framework of the applicable discrimination laws and regulations).

jd:
Looking for *that* internship? The game-changing one that will help you learn, grow, and chart your path forward? You’ll find it at JMP ( a subsidary of SAS) ! Our interns aren’t coffee runners – they do real, meaningful work. Our award-winning internship program is focused on development, culture, and community. We’ll help you grow professionally, find (or further) your passion, and make memorable connections that last beyond the summer.     

 About the job 

 The JMP DevOps team’s goal is to create and maintain the infrastructure for JMP product software and internally used development tools. This role requires knowledge of the software development life cycle, familiarity with a wide variety of scripting and programming languages (e.g., Powershell, Python, Perl, Go) and tools used to automate tasks and processes (e.g., AWS, Jenkins, compilers for MacOSX and Windows, and installer software). The successful intern candidate will play a critical role in understanding and documenting existing processes and working with DevOps team members to improve them for future releases.

 As an intern, you may: 

• Learn about the JMP development process and infrastructure that supports our feature, maintenance and monthly security release cycles 
 
• Collect requirements and complete tooling projects in collaboration with DevOps team members 
 
• Research new technologies and tools 
 
• Review and improve existing process and infrastructure documentation 
 
• Back up team members on routine tasks 
 
• Contribute to other JMP DevOps team projects on an ad-hoc basis 
 
 To be successful in this internship, you should have the following: 

• Undergraduate college student enrolled in an accredited program in one of the folllowing areas of study: Computer Science, not graduating prior to December 2027 
 
• Ability to develop novel solutions to technical problems 
 
• Genuine interest in working with a DevOps infrastructure team 
 
• Experience with data analysis software (JMP experience not required) 
 
• Coding / scripting skills in a variety of languages 
 
• Strong communication and organization skills 
 
• You’re curious, passionate, authentic, and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.  
 
 Timeline   

• Applications open: October 2026   
 
• Interviews begin:  October 2026 on a rolling basis. 

• Internship:  May 18, 2027 – August 6, 2027 (These dates are not flexible. To be considered for the JMP Summer Internship program, all interns must be available to start in person at Cary HQ on May 18, 2027. Summer internships last 12 weeks.) 

 Perks of the job     

• Work with (and learn from) the best. As a JMP intern, you’ll get face time with company leaders and executives.    

• Hybrid work flexibility: Our hybrid approach offers the best of both worlds, combining in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work remotely, aligned with your team’s needs. 

• Free SAS programming training and certification.       

• Your well-being matters. We support all dimensions of your well-being with programs designed to reduce stress and distractions so you can stay healthy and productive. This includes an on-site Work/Life Center, Recreation and Fitness Center, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), subsidized cafés and more.     

• We work hard, but we like to have fun, too. Enjoy hackathons, social events and other opportunities to connect and engage.     

 You are welcome here. 

 At JMP, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

   Additional Information: 

 To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. SAS is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. Read more: Know Your Rights.   

 Resumes may be considered in the order they are received. SAS employees performing certain job functions may require access to technology or software subject to export or import regulations. To comply with these regulations, SAS may obtain nationality or citizenship information from applicants for employment. SAS collects this information solely for trade law compliance purposes and does not use it to discriminate unfairly in the hiring process.    

  SAS and JMP only sends emails from verified “sas.com” or "jmp.com" email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com.   

  Pay transparency: Hourly rates for SAS internships are based on an applicant’s year in school and the role they are hired into. Rates range from $15 to $30 per hour for associate and bachelor’s-level positions and from $29 to $49 per hour for master’s and Ph.D positions. Internship roles are not eligible for bonuses.   

 #JMP
